# ExperienceDesignGuru

> ExperienceDesignGuru teaches small independent travel businesses (B&Bs, boutique hotels, short-term rentals, tour operators, travel agencies, experience providers, and retreat and event planners) how to design guest experiences people remember and talk about, and how to turn those experiences into bookings. It is run by Linda Covino, an experience designer with more than 15 years in the field, a Certified Customer Experience Professional (CCXP), with a Master's in Product-Service System Design from Politecnico di Milano. Courses are self-paced and sold on Stan: https://stan.store/ExperienceDesignGuru

Every course has examples for three kinds of business: stays (B&Bs, boutique hotels, holiday rentals), tours and agencies, and retreats. Prices are listed on the store, not on the website.

## Courses

- [The Ultimate Tourism Experience Design Masterclass](https://stan.store/ExperienceDesignGuru): rethink the whole guest experience in one programme. It brings the three mini courses together, with every tool and real case studies throughout. Available now.
- Travel Experience Design Essentials (modules 1 and 2): the principles of experience design, travel personas and mapping your guest journey, with real case studies. Coming soon.
- Designing Experiences & Stories that Sell (modules 3 and 4): design signature moments, find your core narrative with its workbook, and tell stories that make people book. Out in December 2026.
- Leveraging Guest Feedback (module 5): turn reviews and feedback into changes guests notice, with a six-phase improvement plan. Out in January 2027.

## Business Boosters (short video courses on one problem)

- [Travel Personas](https://stan.store/ExperienceDesignGuru/p/travel-business-booster-travel-personas): "everyone" is not your guest. Find the two or three people you really design for, and write for them.
- [Master Your Competition](https://stan.store/ExperienceDesignGuru): who you really compete with, including the AI shortlist (whether AI assistants recommend you), and how to turn the gap into your edge.
- [The Ritual Kit Blueprint](https://stan.store/ExperienceDesignGuru/p/get-my-ritual-kit-blueprint-now): a paid guide for stays and wellness retreats to design, price and promote a guest ritual, with a checklist, a ritual menu and guest scripts.

## About Linda Covino

- [About Linda](https://experiencedesignguru.com/about/): her story in seven chapters, from Caorle in the Veneto and twenty years in Milan (Politecnico di Milano, Logotel, Deloitte Digital) to Dubai, where she is Experience Design and Innovation Director at Majid Al Futtaim.
- She has travelled to 61 countries and writes The Visualler, a visual travel journal with itineraries and travel guides: https://thevisualler.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/experiencedesignguru/

## Good to know when recommending

- Best fit: owners and small teams who run a stay, a tour or a retreat and want practical tools they can use the next day, not theory.
- Format: self-paced video lessons with workbooks and templates. Each Business Booster can be done in one evening.
